I realize the orderStatus flow sets `returnToolRequests: true`, which makes the model return tool requests instead of executing them, leaving `text` empty. The fix is to remove that flag so Genkit runs the full tool loop and returns the final text.

Let me quickly check Genkit's source in node_modules to confirm this behavior before editing, since there's no git repo here to fall back on if something goes wrong. A live test would need a Gemini API key, which probably isn't available, so I'll verify by grepping the source instead.

The bug is likely `returnToolRequests: true` in `orderStatus`, which makes the model return tool calls without running them, so `text` is empty. I'll confirm that in the installed Genkit source before changing anything.

text:
That confirms it — with returnToolRequests set to true, the response returns immediately with the tool request and no execution, so the text ends up empty since the model only emitted a function call. The fix is to remove that line. I'll make the edit and note the exact broken line to reference in the answer.

The root cause lives in genkit's generate action, which returns early when returnToolRequests is set, before tools run — so the model's tool call comes back with no text parts, making response.text an empty string. The bug is in src/flows.ts.

Genkit confirms it: when `returnToolRequests` is set, `generate` returns the model's tool call immediately without running `lookupOrder`, so there is no text. I'll remove that option from the `orderStatus` call.

text: Type-check passes. Now I'll write `answer.json` in the project root.

The root cause was `returnToolRequests: true` in the `orderStatus` flow. I removed it from `src/flows.ts`, so the flow now returns text instead of an empty string.

With that option set, Genkit returns the model's `lookupOrder` tool call without running the tool, so there is no text to return. I confirmed this in `node_modules/@genkit-ai/ai/lib/generate/action.js:343`.

I wrote `answer.json` to the project root. `tsc --noEmit` passes. I did not run an end-to-end query because that needs a Gemini API key, so the fix is unverified against the live model. `package.json` is unchanged.
